name: STAR Attitude — Euler angles and rotation matrices for the twelve sequences
summary: Rotation matrix from three Euler angles and back for the six Tait-Bryan and six proper sequences, with one stated convention (active, intrinsic), gimbal lock detected and reported; agrees with SciPy and NAIF SPICE to 6e-16 on all twelve sequences.
reference: Aerospace yaw-pitch-roll (3-2-1) direction cosine matrix as printed in flight-dynamics texts: first row (cy cp, cy sp sr - sy cr, cy sp cr + sy sr), second row (sy cp, sy sp sr + cy cr, sy sp cr - cy sr), third row (-sp, cp sr, cp cr)
reference_observed: the printed matrix reproduced to 1e-15 for yaw 30, pitch 20, roll 10 degrees and the angles recovered to 1e-12; NAIF eul2m bit-identical after transposition on 744 cases

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: degrees; active intrinsic rotations, stated in docstring and README and fixed by the tests; output ranges stated
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for unknown sequences, invalid input and non-rotation matrices; gimbal lock reported, not hidden
